newsitem.title: USA: Dow plows to intraday high, NYSE sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow plows to intraday high, NYSE sets curbs.

text.p: U.S. blue chips rode a burst of program trading activity to set an all-time intraday high in late afternoon trading on Monday.

The Dow stood at 7121, up 50 points, moments after peaking at an intraday record 7127.39. The NYSE imposed its index-arbitrage trading curbs at 1450 EDT/1850 GMT, when the Dow's session gains first topped the 50 point mark.
Birinyi Associates said it had tracked a total of six program trades starting in late morning, five of which were on the buy side. The fifth of those buy programs was still underway, the firm said.
